config.intro: What do the exam rules say?

cases.situation: What does an exam at an ISED office cost?
cases.why: ISED charges nothing for qualification exams.

cases.situation: May an accredited examiner charge you?

cases.answer: No, but it can be given orally or tailored

rules-exams.success: Free at ISED, cost recovery with examiners, and accommodation without exemption.
